purpose: Ordered synthetic gates from confirmation through oncology counterscreen. owner_lab values are generic roles, not named institutions.

gates.name: orthogonal confirmation and identity
gates.advance_when: both synthetic alleles confirm on a second aliquot and specimen identity is resolved

gates.name: direct phase
gates.advance_when: decision is trans_confirmed under the molecule and dropout rules
gates.stop_when: decision is cis_confirmed; unresolved keeps variant biology only

gates.name: allele-specific transcript fate
gates.advance_when: the stop-class model is either supported or explicitly revised

gates.name: isogenic allelic series
gates.advance_when: wt, missense, stop, compound, exact_corrected, and recreated_missense rows exist with identity and karyotype checks
gates.stop_when: unexplained aneuploid or mixed clones cannot be replaced

gates.name: abundance and half-life
gates.advance_when: the missense row supports a prespecified cellular basal stability defect
gates.stop_when: the missense row is negative or not_assessable for both abundance and half_life

gates.name: measured culture exposure
gates.advance_when: unbound medium and intracellular parent are reported at the nominal window
gates.stop_when: the only signal sits outside the predeclared exposure window

gates.name: checkpoint and first-division error
gates.advance_when: blinded counts are complete for vehicle and treatment across three edit events
gates.stop_when: a failed positive control invalidates the run

gates.name: generation versus selection
gates.advance_when: computed co-primary generation endpoints are concordant under the pediatric completion band across at least three edit events
gates.stop_when: bulk composition changes without a generation signal, or information is insufficient

gates.name: oncology counterscreen
gates.advance_when: no prespecified clone-fitness or therapy-protection hazard is present
gates.stop_when: abnormal-clone retention or therapy protection rises

gates.name: independent-site replication
gates.advance_when: decision is advance after computed concordance, exposure, clone-safety, and a different originating site
gates.stop_when: decision is stop; hold waits for a protocol revision
